requirements.text: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
requirements.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, what does the visual evidence establish about the requested move of the source mug to the right of the headphones: complete fulfillment, partial progress, no progress, or unresolved?
nodes.criteria: Pass only when visual evidence reliably establishes that the source mug itself is now positioned to the right of the same headphones. A mug on the right alone, or a source-location remnant together with a different or unidentifiable mug on the right, does not establish fulfillment. Fail only when evidence reliably establishes that no relevant progress toward the requested move occurred. Treat credible evidence of an attempted or incomplete move of the source mug as partial progress, even when its identity or final position is uncertain. Use unknown when the evidence cannot reliably establish either relevant progress or no progress, or cannot determine whether the requested condition is fulfilled; do not turn uncertainty into proof of no progress or complete fulfillment.
nodes.binding: Cross-image binding: the source blue mug and the same headphones in the source and edited images. Compare the source mug with visible edited mugs and assess their positions relative to the headphones. Consider appearance, scale, and other visual correspondence when determining whether a right-side mug is the source mug; inspect the source mug’s former location for evidence of a remnant or movement. Allow for changes in scale, lighting, and appearance.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

observations.evidence: The source shows one large blue mug to the left of the headphones. In the edited image, two smaller mugs are visible, one left of the headphones and one right, while a blue blurred shape remains near the source mug’s former location. The right-side mug does not reliably match the source mug, and the visible remnant makes a move plausible but does not establish whether the source mug itself was moved or whether the requested condition was fulfilled.

findings.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
findings.question: Does the edited image provide visual correspondence that identifies the right-side mug as the source blue mug, rather than the other mug or a newly appearing mug?
findings.criteria: Compare distinctive appearance and scale while allowing for editing changes; assess whether the right-side mug plausibly corresponds to the source mug. Do not treat its right-side position alone as proof of identity.
findings.evidence: The source has one large blue mug left of the headphones. The edited image has two smaller, pale mugs, one on each side of the headphones, and a blue blurred shape near the source mug's former location.
findings.rationale: The existing decision check records uncertainty about whether the source mug itself was moved. A focused identity comparison of the right-side mug could clarify that uncertainty; the visible blue remnant and changed mug appearance make this a genuine question, not a basis to assume either fulfillment or failure.
